cases.note: Read as a file, either base resolves ./x to f/a/fl/x and ../shared_lib to f/a/shared_lib. Resolving and bundling the imports is the build's (C2a, F4).
cases.title: the default import base, at top level and inside a loop

files.f/a/fl.flow/flow.yaml:
value:
  modules:
    - id: s
      value:
        type: rawscript
        language: bun
        content: "export async function main() { return 1 }"
        input_transforms: {}
    - id: l
      value:
        type: forloopflow
        iterator: {type: static, value: [1]}
        modules:
          - id: s
            value:
              type: rawscript
              language: bun
              content: "export async function main() { return 1 }"
              input_transforms: {}

cases.note: The base resolves ./x to f/elsewhere/x; resolving it is the build's (C2a, F4).
cases.title: an explicit path overrides the import base

files.f/x/main.flow/flow.yaml:
value:
  modules:
    - id: s
      value:
        type: rawscript
        path: f/elsewhere/entry
        language: bun
        content: "export async function main() { return 1 }"
        input_transforms: {}

value:
  preprocessor_module:
    id: pre
    value:
      type: rawscript
      language: bun
      content: 'export async function preprocessor() { return {} }'
      input_transforms: {}
  modules:
    - id: a
      value: {type: script, path: f/x/s}

note: The import base the inventory records for each script (WR-29); the build resolves relative imports against it.
